name: Voice acting evaluation 2026-10 (docs/VOICE-ENGINE.md)
note: The producer's six tests. `text` is the line as written (what Habibi hears after prepareLineText, and what Fish 'plain' hears). `tagged` is the same words with Fish S2 Pro's own acting mechanism: free-form inline [tags] before the words they colour (fishaudio/s2-pro model card). The words never change between arms. Seeds are fixed; one attempt per arm per test.

tests.intent: warm, a little worried, relieved to find him; then mild exasperation
tests.text: شلونك حبيبي، وينك من الصبح؟ صارلي ساعة أدور عليك!
tests.tagged: [warm, relieved] شلونك حبيبي، وينك من الصبح؟ [mildly exasperated] صارلي ساعة أدور عليك!

tests.text: يمعود گتلك لا تفتح الباب! ليش ما تسمع الحچي؟
tests.tagged: [angry, shouting] يمعود گتلك لا تفتح الباب! [frustrated] ليش ما تسمع الحچي؟

tests.intent: whispered, tense, afraid of being heard
tests.text: اسكت شوية... أكو واحد واقف ورا الباب.
tests.tagged: [whispering] اسكت شوية... [tense whisper] أكو واحد واقف ورا الباب.

tests.intent: hurt, quiet disappointment, close to tears
tests.text: آني چنت واثق بيك... ما توقعت منك هيچ.
tests.tagged: [sad, hurt] آني چنت واثق بيك... [quiet, disappointed] ما توقعت منك هيچ.

tests.text: هااا! أخيراً وصلت! تدري شكد فرحت من شفتك؟
tests.tagged: [laughing] هااا! [excited] أخيراً وصلت! [joyful] تدري شكد فرحت من شفتك؟

tests.text: I can't believe you're here. We've been looking for you all night.
tests.tagged: [relieved, emotional] I can't believe you're here. [exhausted] We've been looking for you all night.
